Ordinary Ranged Weapon

You check your weapon with the familiar care that makes the first shot feel right.

Rules

- ID: item-ordinary-ranged-weapon - Bulk: 1 - Requirements / supply: No DP; ordinary equipment - Acquisition: Explicit ability grant, coins, or DA treasure; no automatic extra starting kit.

A ranged implement described by its owner. Attack card supplies mechanics. Uses a separate ammunition bundle where required. Two hands while in use.

No DP price. Purchase does not grant training or an ability.

Equipment index

Market price: 18 coins. Proposal; see @UUID[Compendium.heroes-of-legend.player-rules.JournalEntry.a8b099af3500d9f6.JournalEntryPage.cfa94361944ba875]{market rules}.
